private_corpus.note: Isolated soft/hard pluck, pop, slap, muted/ghost, rapid same-string repetition and rhythmic patterns. Bridge-piezo, fingerboard/contact and body/microphone paths recorded separately where possible. Performer consent, licence, checksums and redistribution rights are stored with the private corpus only; no private audio enters Git history or public evidence.
private_corpus.deliverable_rule: Only derived non-audio measurements and source citations may be committed.

commercial_audio_policy: Commercial audio remains outside Git history and public evidence; only derived non-audio measurements and source citations may be committed.

splits.calibration: private corpus gestures assigned per performer/session
splits.held_out: isolated pluck/pop/slap/ghost gestures reserved for G-004 listening

preset_policy: No artist preset may claim measured reproduction before fitting and listening evidence exist.
